purpose: Bounded source-clone candidate detection, not an absolute non-similarity certificate

method.exact: Comments and whitespace removed; all identifiers, literals and operators preserved. Every matching seed is extended maximally and collision-verified.
method.renamed: Complete ///| blocks with consistently bijective identifier renaming; reserved keywords, listed built-in type names and literals retained. User-defined type names are normalized with other identifiers.
method.excluded: Local tests, interfaces, non-MoonBit files and snippets below thresholds. Foreign tests excluded only when include_foreign_tests=false; generated files excluded only when include_generated=false and leading comments explicitly declare generation.
method.source_decoding: Strict UTF-8 with optional BOM; BOM-declared UTF-16/32 decoded strictly. Other invalid source bytes remain explicit exclusions.

limitations: Coverage is the available version-pinned source collection and explicit exclusions in this result, not all history or unpublished Mooncakes code.
This lexical scanner is not a complete MoonBit parser; unusual string/comment syntax and unsupported constructs require manual review.
Semantic equivalence, reordered or substantially edited code, subthreshold snippets, comments, other languages and unpublished/history versions are not proven absent.
A candidate is not plagiarism; attribution, standard algorithms and source history require human review.
No candidate does not establish absolute source originality or contest eligibility.
